import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int mod1 = 998244353;
    static final int mod2 = 1000000007;
    static final int Base = 1000000;

    static int n, tot, ans;
    static int[] sum = new int[15];
    static List<Integer>[] vec = new ArrayList[15];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());

        for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
            vec[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        dfs1(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 7; i++) {
            Collections.sort(vec[i]);
        }
        tot = 0;
        ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs2(i);
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    static void dfs1(int k, int num) {
        if (k == 7) return;
        tot++;
        int back = ((tot - num) % mod1 + mod1) % mod1;
        vec[k].add(back);
        sum[k] = (sum[k] + back) % mod2;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs1(k + 1, num * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static void dfs2(int x) {
        if (x > n) return;
        if (x * Base + Base - 1 <= n && x * Base * 10 > n) {
            int now = tot;
            int mul = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++, mul *= 10) {
                int sz = vec[i].size();
                int dif = ((now - x * mul) % mod1 + mod1) % mod1;
                int pos = lowerBound(vec[i], (int)(mod1 - dif));
                ans = (ans + (long)dif * sz + sum[i]) % mod2;
                ans = (int)((ans - (long)mod1 * (sz - pos) % mod2 + mod2) % mod2);
                tot += sz;
            }
            return;
        }
        tot++;
        ans = (ans + ((tot - x) % mod1 + mod1) % mod1) % mod2;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs2(x * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }
}
